radiation.scope: Upgoing propagating power below 80°, estimated from the finite rectangular air-plane aperture after complex incident-field subtraction. Each bin integrates azimuth; uncollected lateral light and grazing waves lie outside the aperture estimate.

comparisons.scope: Same dimensions, finite teeth, 50 µm taper, residual film extending laterally and same port observable; uniform local grid, rectangular aperture and a paraxial TFSF surface beam.

Filed curved 38-period SOI sector, unlike the Tidy3D uniform linear grating. The S21 magnitude in this file is squared to obtain the transfer power between the tilted fiber port and the integrated guide.
